slides.image_prompt: The YouTube logo offering free courses so good they feel illegal, dominating the education world

caption:
12 free YouTube courses that replace an MBA. Hormozi, Naval and Huberman are all on the list. 🎓

1) Sell like the top 1%. Alex Hormozi's "How to Sell Better than 99% Of People" on YouTube. The exact scripts, no theory. Free.

2) Lead any room. Natalie C Dawson's "How To Speak Like The 1% Elite." The words that make people actually listen. Free.

3) Think so clearly people assume you're a genius. Sandeep Swadia walks through his thinking system step by step. Free.

4) Better storytelling in 18 minutes. Philipp Humm's one structure makes anything you say stick. Claims 183% improvement. Free.

5) Negotiate like a pro. Matthias Schranner's TEDx "Negotiation Skills for Life." Worth coming back to every year. Free.

6) Be so productive it feels illegal. Dan Martell's system for squeezing 5 hours of deep work into
2. Free.

7) Study smarter, not harder. Huberman breaks down the exact brain-science protocol behind long-term retention. Free.

8) Build AI automations and sell them. Nick Saraev's "N8N Course." Build the agents, package them, sell them to businesses. Free.

9) Learn Claude AI from scratch. Walks you from zero to your first Claude workflow in under an hour. Free.

10) Manage money like the quietly wealthy. The exact spreadsheet habits the quietly wealthy use, savings rate, buckets, the order. Free.

11) Lock in focus on command. Rian Doris's "How To Unlock Insane Focus On Command." Elite performers use this daily. Free.

12) 44 harsh truths about the game of life. Naval and Chris Williamson hold nothing back. Free.

SAVE THIS: all 12 free on YouTube, no sign-up, no credit card.

The best business education in the world is free now. Hormozi built $100M+ before teaching these scripts. Naval backed dozens of startups before posting his framework. The playbook is on YouTube.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: natan_mohart
